name: Pleasure Domain
body:
Deity: deities of pleasure

Granted Powers: You can grant others the glory of the pleasure god’s rapture with just a touch, and the pleasure god’s joy fills your heart to overflowing.

Rapturous Touch (Su): You can touch a creature as a standard action, granting them a +2 bonus to any one Perform check for one round.

Pleasure’s Heart (Su): Beginning at 8th level, your heart is so full of joy that you are immune to non-magical fear effects and receive a +2 bonus to saving throws against magical fear effects.

Domain Spells: 1st—charm person, 2nd—mantle of love, 3rd—suggestion, 4th—beauty of youth, 5th—break enchantment, 6th—symbol of persuasion, 7th—repulsion, 8th—peace aura, 9th—true resurrection.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
